description: This is a Python test script for the TDK (Test Development Kit) framework that tests the CosaCM_GetStatus API related to Cable Modem status in the RDKB environment. The script sets up a test case, executes the API call, and verifies the response, including logging results and validation. It relies on external modules like tdklib and performs module loading, test step creation, parameter setting, and result evaluation.
